newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BERRY CALLED UP TO REPLACE INJURED GILCHRIST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BERRY CALLED UP TO REPLACE INJURED GILCHRIST.

text.p: Australia have called up Darren Berry of Victoria to replace reserve wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist, who has had to fly home with a serious knee injury.
Tour manager Alan Crompton said on Saturday that Gilchrist would have his knee in a brace for four more weeks, but would hope to be fit for the start of the Australian summer season.
He is the second player to go home because of injury. Paceman Andy Bichel was replaced by Paul Reiffel earlier in the tour.
Berry is already in England, playing and coaching at Macclesfield, just a few miles from Manchester where the third test is currently being played.
